citation: Kristensen JM, et al. Physiol Rep 2019;7:e14307
protocol: Placebo arm of the acute study: overnight fast, standard breakfast with placebo, then 40 min one-legged knee-extensor exercise at 80% of peak work load; blood hourly 0:00 to 2:30 h after dosing (glucose, insulin, lactate, adrenaline, noradrenaline)
population: Healthy moderately trained lean men (BMI 22-24), n = 9 in the acute study and 10 in the short-term study
note: Small-muscle-mass exercise (one leg), so systemic values are modest; metformin columns to be ignored; muscle metabolite table also present.
